summary: Iteration 7: Validated the two Render deploy-blocker fixes (lucide-react Eye import, R2 upload endpoint hardening) plus the newly-added /api/purchases endpoint. Ran 10 pytest tests against the public preview backend URL and executed the production frontend build. All checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1700 lines and mixes auth, courses, wallet, referrals, admin, media, payments concerns. Recommend splitting into routers under /app/backend/routes/* for maintainability. Not blocking deploy.

storage_service._client() uses @lru_cache and reads env at first call. Because backend loads /app/backend/.env at import time and R2 keys are only on Render, this is fine in production. But note: if env vars are ever set AFTER the first call to _client(), the cache will hide them. Consider clearing the cache in a health-check or removing lru_cache if hot reload of secrets is desired.
ALLOWED_*_TYPES constants are duplicated in server.py (lines 1527-1529) and storage_service.py. Keep a single source of truth.

`/api/media/files/{file_key:path}` streams full file into memory via download_file(); large videos (up to 500MB per storage_service limits) will spike memory. Consider using generate_presigned_url + redirect, or a streaming iterator via boto3 get_object Body.iter_chunks. Not blocking, but a scaling concern.
test_credentials: Seeded admin session for admin@meramentor.in via /app/backend/tests/create_admin_session.py. Token is generated per-run; token from this run was used successfully against /api/auth/me and /api/purchases and /api/admin/media/upload.
seed_data_creation: Inserted a UserSession row (1-day expiry) for admin@meramentor.in. Admin User row is upserted if missing (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend build verified with `CI=true DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN=true yarn build` -> Compiled successfully (Eye import from lucide-react 0.507.0 works; caret removed in package.json). /api/purchases exists and returns [] for admin. /api/admin/media/upload returns clean 503 with all four CLOUDFLARE_R2_* env-var names in the detail when R2 not configured (locally the case). R2 boto3 client wiring verified: endpoint https://<account_id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, region_name='auto', signature_version='s3v4', addressing_style='path'. Real R2 uploads should succeed on Render once redeployed. Do NOT try to test real uploads locally — no creds. See /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_deploy_fixes.py for regression harness.
rca of the issue: Bug #1 (Eye import): package.json had `lucide-react: ^0.507.0`. Since yarn.lock isn't shipped, Render's fresh install resolved to a newer lucide-react where the `Eye` icon export path had shifted, causing the CRA build to fail with 'Attempted import error'. Fix: pin exact `0.507.0`. Verified by running the same build command Render uses (`CI=true DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN=true yarn build`) locally -> Compiled successfully. Bug #2 (500 on upload): was a downstream symptom — the old Emergent-storage code was still deployed because bug #1 blocked the new R2 build. Additionally, server.py:1533 now short-circuits with a 503 (not 500) when R2 env vars are missing, and wraps storage_upload() in try/except that returns 502 with a clean message on any boto3 failure. Once user redeploys with the pinned lucide-react, the R2 code path will actually deploy and uploads will succeed since their R2 env vars are already set on Render.
